provenance.attribution: Recorded Antigravity / gemini-3.8-flash-high run; configured model, no provider-internal attestation.
provenance.sourceAccess: Fresh project-local authoring workspace with a brief, installed skills and Kiln tools.
provenance.humanIntervention: Maintainer supplied the brief and reviewed actual exports and uniform gallery posters. Final source bytes are preserved from the model export. Later maintainer revision (2026-11-12): flush-face fix by Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Claude Code, 7 part edits that separate coplanar faces; materials, names, hierarchy and animation are unchanged, and the source is no longer byte-identical to the model's export.
provenance.reviewFidelity: Actual GPU images inspected independently. Roof highlights remain bright. Tracked motion and mechanical clearance are not certified; this is a stylized expedition vehicle.
provenance.poster: Archival GPU poster from the source before the 2026-11-12 flush-face fix. The original receipt is retained as historicalPosterReceipt; this image is not an exact-source render of the current program.

maintainerRevisions.description: Flush-face fix by Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Claude Code (2026-11-12). WindshieldGlass: position x 0.89 -> 0.892 so the glass outer face stands about 1.9 mm proud of the frame face; SideWinFront/AftGlass L,R: z offset 0.005 -> 0.007 so glass stands 2 mm proud of frame; RoadWheel_*: depth 0.26 -> 0.252 so rim faces no longer lie on the sprocket rim faces; NoseFairingIvory: y 0.76 -> 0.758 so its bottom sits 2 mm below the nose slope bottom; GprAntennaSled: y 0.28 -> 0.278 so bottom sits 2 mm below the chassis tub bottom; SolarBusbar_L/R_*: y offset +0.003 -> +0.005 so busbar bottoms no longer sit 0.5 mm from cell bottoms; SpectrometerOptic: x -0.56 -> -0.562 so its end cap is 2 mm proud of the cab side

historicalPosterReceipt.purpose: Gallery poster generated from the exact downloadable GLB; separate from authoring feedback.
